Historical customer review screenshot

( All five-star reviews for AET )

Selecting international credential evaluation services in Miami FL can be a challenge, as there are many different evaluation services available. However, not all are created equal. Here are some of the things we recommend looking for in foreign credential evaluation services:

1. Start with an agency that has local five-star reviews. American Education and Translation Services has had all five-star reviews on Google Map.

2. Look for Miami international credential evaluation services that have extensive experience - avoid fly-by-night agencies. American Education and Translation Services has 10 years of experience and completes thousands of translations a year.

3. Stick to credential evaluation services with a strong track record. Our company has excellent reviews on Google and Yelp. People trust us for high quality translation services, visa services and credential evaluation services.

4. While a reputable service should provide professional translation services, it’s still important to have a guarantee. If necessary corrections need to be made, please contact us, as we guarantee our work.
